info.headline: Cancellation of Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Central Coast and Whitsundays, Capricornia and Central Highlands and Coalfields forecast districts
info.description:
This warning is now cancelled.
106 km/h wind gust was recorded at Wellcamp Airport at 4:07 pm 4 to 5 cm hail was observed in the Warwick area late Tuesday afternoon 3 to 4 cm hail was observed around Miles around 3 pm
info.instruction: Emergency services advise people to: * Never drive, walk, play or ride through floodwater. It is dangerous. * Stay away from storm water drains. * Stay away from fallen powerlines. * Drive slowly and never drive through floodwaters. If the road is flooded or damaged, go another way. * For storm help, call the SES on 132 500 or download the free SES Assistance QLD app.
